title: Resident Evil 6 Benchmark Tool
provenance: Started here on an M4 with macOS 27.0 on 2026-10-05, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, the Steam copy: after Capcom's EULA and Steam's first-run DirectX and Visual C++ installers, the title screen (Press any key) comes up full screen at 120 s. The benchmark itself was not run, so not marked verified.
notes: Capcom's free benchmark for Resident Evil 6, a Direct3D 9 game, so it draws through DXVK's Direct3D 9 in every graphics mode but wined3d. On the default engine it reaches its title screen; no score was taken.

knownIssues.symptom: The benchmark loses the GPU while loading, a black screen after Benchmark is chosen (VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY, then device lost in DXVK)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. Measured on an M4 on 2026-11-03 with the Wine 11 engine r28 and a candidate r31, both through DXVK's Direct3D 9, with 88% of memory free, so not the Mac running short
knownIssues.fix: none known yet. wined3d mode is untried
